groups.title: Generators
groups.body: The chain opens by rewriting every generated file from its source, so each validator after it reads fresh data. These write files and check nothing themselves.

groups.title: Generated files match their source
groups.body: Each of these regenerates a file in memory and compares it byte for byte with the copy on disk, so a hand edit or a skipped generator fails the build.

groups.title: Registries match the repo
groups.body: Each registry is the one home of a list. These hold it to the folders, pages and files it describes, in both directions.

groups.title: The component contract
groups.body: The mechanical half of the props contract every published component follows.

groups.title: Tokens and CSS
groups.body: The token tiers, the themes, and the rules component and site CSS follow.

groups.title: The site, the chat and the prose
groups.body: What the chat answers from, the chips it draws, and the rules shipped copy keeps.

groups.title: Verify, after the chain
groups.body: The rest of verify, in the order it runs. The two builds each run the whole chain again first, and the website build runs its own subset of it.

groups.title: In CI only
groups.body: CI runs every step of verify across its four jobs, plus these two, which a local run cannot do.

generate-skills-content.text: Writes the /skills page data from every registered SKILL.md.

generate-brand-module.text: Writes the typed mirror of scripts/brand.mjs that site code reads.

generate-readme-content.text: Rewrites the README's component count and list, badge, banner link and author credit.

generate-token-registry.text: Writes the semantic token registry from the token CSS.

generate-preset-stylesheets.text: Writes one shippable stylesheet per theme preset, plus the aggregate.

generate-token-values.text: Resolves every token per theme and mode into values.json and the DTCG files.

generate-theme-design-md.text: Writes a DESIGN.md file for every shipped theme.

generate-library-barrel.text: Writes src/index.ts and src/charts.ts from the component registry.

sync-blueprints.text: Copies the root specs into the website for the /blueprints pages.

generate-site-corpus.text: Builds the one document the site chat answers from.

generate-component-api.text: Writes the prop reference the MCP endpoint serves.

generate-component-md.text: Writes a markdown page per component, served beside its docs page.

generate-component-schema.text: Writes a JSON schema per component from its props interface, plus the index.

generate-shadcn-registry.text: Writes the shadcn registry, the third way to install a component.

generate-agent-skill.text: Builds the consumer agent skills and AGENTS.md that init installs.

generate-dependency-graph.text: Writes the /graph data from primitives through to pages.

generate-google-font-index.text: Writes the Google Fonts index the playground's importer reads.

generate-brand-marks.text: Writes the brand marks the DESIGN.md importer can show.

generate-a11y-coverage.text: Writes the figures on the accessibility foundations page.

generate-quality-gate.text: Writes this page's list from package.json and the CI workflow.

validate-google-font-index.text: The playground's font index matches its generator.

validate-brand-marks.text: The importer's brand marks match their generator.

validate-brand-module.text: The typed brand module matches scripts/brand.mjs.

validate-site-corpus.text: The chat corpus is fresh, carries no leaked contact details and fits its token budget.

validate-component-api.text: The prop reference the MCP endpoint serves is fresh.

validate-component-md.text: Every component's markdown page matches its source, with no orphans.

validate-component-schema.text: Every component's schema and the schema index match their source.

validate-shadcn-registry.text: The shadcn registry matches its sources, with no stale, missing or orphan files.

validate-agent-skill.text: The consumer skills and their manifest match their source.

validate-a11y-coverage.text: The accessibility page's figures are fresh.

validate-token-registry.text: The token registry matches the token CSS.

validate-token-values.text: values.json and the DTCG files match the token CSS and the preset composer.

validate-preset-stylesheets.text: Every preset stylesheet and the aggregate match the composer.

validate-theme-design-md.text: The per-theme DESIGN.md files regenerate exactly and still read back through the importer.

validate-component-registry.text: Every component folder is in exactly one registry list, and every entry has a folder.

validate-website-surfaces.text: Every component has its site page, preview, design.md spec and nav entries.

validate-page-titles.text: Every component page has a layout with a real browser tab title.

validate-skills-registry.text: Every skill folder is registered, and the /skills data agrees.

validate-release-log.text: One entry per npm version, newest first, with valid versions and dates.

validate-loops.text: The loops registry is complete and names only skills that exist.

validate-template-thumbnails.text: Every template has a still in every mode, and no still is left over.

validate-nav-panels.text: The mega panels' icon tables match the sidebar lists they are built from.

validate-mcp-tools.text: Every stated MCP tool count matches the tools the route registers.

validate-chat-widget.text: The chat widget's registry matches the widget it describes.

validate-blocks.text: The blocks registry matches the block templates on disk.

validate-package-exports.text: package.json's name, version, exports and bin match the manifest, and the lockfile agrees.

validate-local-labs.text: No tracked file imports from a gitignored local folder.

validate-prop-docs.text: Every own prop has a JSDoc description.

validate-component-contract.text: The ref, the rest spread, the client directive and the other mechanical rules of the props contract.

validate-overlay-listeners.text: Only the layer stack listens for Escape and outside presses, and key bindings go through useShortcut.

validate-accessible-names.text: No literal English accessible name; each one is a prop.

validate-visible-text.text: No literal English text on screen; each string is a prop.

validate-locale-formatting.text: Nothing formats a number or a date in the runtime's default locale.

validate-prop-vocabulary.text: The variant, tone and size vocabulary, the controlled and uncontrolled pairs, and internal callers on current spellings.

validate-json-schemas.text: Every generated schema validates against its hand-written meta-schema.

validate-class-names.text: Base classes are ds- plus the name in kebab case, with --modifier and __part.

validate-shared-primitives.text: Shared marks and controls are composed, never redrawn.

validate-shader-background.text: The background config sits inside the tuner's ranges, and its blob colours exist.

validate-single-background-mount.text: BlurBackground is mounted exactly once, in the root layout.

validate-token-references.text: Semantic colours point at primitives through var(), never a hex value.

validate-theme-mirrors.text: Hand mirrors of token data in the site and design.md match the CSS.

validate-foundation-mirrors.text: The values the foundations pages print match the CSS.

validate-theme-export.text: The playground's exported AGENTS.md, CSS and THEME.md describe the system correctly.

validate-design-md-import.text: The DESIGN.md importer still reads files by its rules.

validate-theme-presets.text: Every preset sets every lever and passes the contrast gate.

validate-token-usage.text: Every var(--…) a stylesheet references resolves.

validate-action-colour.text: The action colour appears only in the roles design.md reserves it for.

validate-css-directives.text: Every ds-allow directive follows the grammar and names a known category.

validate-raw-values.text: No literal colour, timing, type or off-scale value in the package's CSS.

validate-logical-properties.text: Package CSS uses logical properties, so layout follows the reading direction.

validate-design-counts.text: The family sizes design.md states in words match the token CSS.

validate-js-timings.text: Timer delays come from motion.ts, never a literal.

validate-breakpoints.text: Every media query width is one of the breakpoint set.

validate-stacking.text: Every z-index of 10 or more names a layer token.

validate-tier-colours.text: Display and heading text take their tier's colour role.

validate-table-styles.text: Every table draws from the one table token family.

validate-analytics-events.text: Events go out only through SITE_EVENTS and trackEvent.

validate-chat-coverage.text: Every golden-set fact is in the corpus, and every route is covered or excluded with a reason.

validate-chat-starters.text: Every written chat suggestion fits on one chip.

validate-page-summaries.text: Every static page has a summary and starters, or is chromeless.

validate-shipped-prose.text: No em dash in shipped copy.

validate-page-prose-width.text: No width cap on a component page's prose.

validate-doc-refs.text: Every repo path, npm script and API symbol a doc or skill names exists.

validate-quality-gate.text: This page's list matches package.json and the CI workflow.

npm run build.text: Runs the whole chain above, then type-checks the library.

validate-api-compat.text: Against the latest release tag, no prop, export, subpath, file, bin or schema property vanished or narrowed.

npm run build:lib.text: Builds the publishable package into dist/.

validate-package-publish.text: publint and arethetypeswrong against dist/, so every subpath resolves for every kind of consumer.

npm run test.text: Every Storybook story as a render, axe and interaction test in headless Chromium.

npm run build-storybook.text: Runs the chain again, then builds the static Storybook.

npm --prefix website run build.text: Runs the website's subset of the chain, then the Next build.

validate-rendered-spacing.text: No space lost after an inline closing tag in the prerendered HTML.

validate-corpus-coverage.text: Each covered page's rendered prose actually reached the chat corpus.

validate-internal-links.text: Every internal link leads to a page, a route handler, a public file or a redirect.

smoke-hydration.text: Serves the build in a real browser: hydration succeeds and every sampled page shows real content.

validate-gestures.text: Drives every drag grip with a fast pointer flood under CPU throttling, and fails if the page breaks.

validate-website-a11y.text: axe over the served pages in light, dark and forced colours.

npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev.text: Fails on a high-severity advisory in a production dependency.

Check generated content is committed.text: After the generators run, the tree has no diff and no untracked file, so nothing regenerated was left uncommitted.
